legal.body:
Belkhidmah respects your privacy. We collect only what we need to deliver home services (such as name, mobile number, and address) to process bookings and improve the app.

We do not sell your data. Limited information may be shared with operations and payment providers solely to fulfill a request.

You may ask us to correct or delete your data through the contact channels on this site.

This is a starter policy and will be replaced by the official legal text.
